test_item:
KeyInstall feature shall allow a reattempt of key installation if previous attempt was unsuccessful.
(installation is re-triggered after a failed attempt)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. An unsuccessful installation has been made on the DUT
3. A USB drive containing valid platform keys has been inserted into the HU USB port
proc:
1. Read the installation state file in the secure partition
$ adb shell od -t x1 /mnt/vendor/oemkeys/<installstate file>
er: 1. The adb shell od -t x1 /mnt/vendor/oemkeys/<installstate file> output shows the installstate value 1
design: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
author: PeiPYHsu
remarks:
source: 037 SWE1-KeyInsyall-004 Requirement Description and Verification Criteria
sibling axis: re-attempt; rule 1 of SEC-04 4.2
channel_feasible: Y/Y
